style: Original 1990s nautical adventure painted pixel art, crisp pixel clusters, midnight indigo and teal shadows, amber lanterns, crooked stone and brass public works. Landscape 1536x1024. No UI, no readable lettering, no people.

jobs.command: Walkable central command floor beneath a rocky lighthouse. Vast spectacular brass tide chart drum behind a safety rail at rear, three illuminated miniature harbour indicators rear centre, command lectern left, small emergency lever to right. Dry inspection door far right and personnel stair left. Wide unbroken dry foreground floor bottom third. Eye level theatrical adventure background.
jobs.bypass: Walkable dry inspection gallery behind glass overlooking enormous brass machinery. Three distinct conduits command, power and signal along back wall, captive coupling handle centre, three-channel reply desk left, labelled blank warning plates, independent gate telltales. Door left. Broad dry foreground floor bottom third. Eye level theatrical adventure background.
jobs.watch: Close-up navigation and telephone desk, three distinct station cards with blank text areas, brass telephone, routing diagrams, pencil and dated stamp, readable spacious composition.
jobs.coupling: Close-up mechanical maintenance panel: three physically separate conduits, one brass command coupling, power cable continuous, public signal return continuous. Three seated gate-position holds and three small indicator lamps. Clear practical geometry, restrained ornamental brass.
jobs.passage: Wide dramatic panorama of Bellweather rocky shoal and Brindle Quay at night, three amber station lights answering across indigo water, one modest public supply lighter safely crossing between a warehouse corner and lighthouse notch. Grand warm hopeful atmosphere, not fireworks or combat.
jobs.review: Public harbour charter review in a warm stone quay hall. Open evidence documents on table, company charter, three empty chairs for panel, printing press and public notice rack at side. No royal throne, no prison, no crowd.
jobs.chart: Close-up practical public nautical chart on print compositor table, fixed lighthouse and warehouse landmarks, dated sounding symbols, deliberately blank unsurveyed coast with dotted boundary, brass compass, pencil and stacks of printed copies. No treasure cross, no skull.
jobs.ending: Grand finale wide panorama at sunrise: modest small single-masted patchwork survey boat with teal trim and compact cabin leaving a welcoming working harbour, sounding reel and provisions aboard, public chart rack on quay, amber lighthouse behind, open coast ahead. Distinct from cream cabin motor launch, no people close-up.
